## Summary

The implementation is complete. Here's what was done:

### Work Completed:
- **Created directory and copied style images**: Created `frontend/public/images/styles/` and copied all 10 style images (Group 31.png through Group 40.png) from `onboarding/Style/`
- **Updated StylePreference type**: Added optional `longDescription?: string` field to the interface in `user-profile-types.ts`
- **Updated styleOptions array**: Replaced the previous 10 styles with new ones using local image paths and added longDescription for each:
  - Removed: `streetwear`, `romantic`
  - Added: `eccentric`, `vanilla`
  - All styles now use local images at `/images/styles/Group XX.png`
- **Redesigned selected styles display**: Changed from text pills to thumbnail images (~60x80px) with X button overlay in the top-right corner, with pink border matching the primary color
- **Updated style card rendering**: Changed title format from separate name/description to "Name · Description" (e.g., "Minimal · Timeless") with longDescription shown below in smaller gray text
- **Removed Mystery Style emoji fallback**: Since Mystery Style now has a proper image (Group 40.png), removed the special `🎲` emoji case
- **Validation**: Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors; lint warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to these changes
